name: 3-Cheese & Avocado Sandwich with Corn Chips, Black Olives & Kiwi

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Place corn chips in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim kiwi; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thick half-moons. Place in the first small compartment of the bento box.
Drain olives. Place in the second small compartment of the bento box.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thick half-moons. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ avocado
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place bread on a flat surface; spread one slice with mayo and the other slice with mustard. Layer avocado and cheese over one of the slices. Close with the second slice of bread, then cut in half. Place sandwich in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 slice white bread
2 tsp mayonnaise
1 tsp yellow mustard
1 slice Muenster cheese, sliced
1 slice mozzarella cheese, sliced
1 slice American cheese

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
